messages:
support-ana: FYI getting multiple customer tickets + alerts — hosted API 502/504 spike starting ~08:05 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.team/r/hosted/latency?range=1h :rotating_light:
leo-sre: seeing it in infra graphs too. 5xx rate jumped to 3.8% from 0.2% at 08:05. Traces show gateway timeouts to model-pool nodes.
ben-eng: any recent rollouts or flag flips?
maya-ml: we pushed a staged config at 08:03 to adjust routing tags for the new short-seq kernel. Canary weight was 10%.
ryan-oncall: tagging deploy-bot to confirm rollout details @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.17-routetag-rollout started at 2026-03-17T08:03:12Z. Target routes: tagged=shortseq-v2, canary weight=10%. No automatic rollback configured.
carla-ops: support is getting billing complaints too — clients getting repeated 502s, retries causing doubled token usage. Need mitigation ASAP.
leo-sre: repro steps from a failing request:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large-open","input":"test","max_tokens":64}'
```
Response headers show upstream 502; gateway logs: `upstream_timeout: remote_write failed (recv error)`.
ben-eng: quick check — the rollout introduced a new route tag `shortseq-v2` but the kernel selector in runtime expects `shortseq-v2-quant` (suffixed) due to previous naming. Looks like mismatch. If requests route to tag without deployed kernel, they hit a fallback path that times out.
maya-ml: ugh we changed the tag name in the recipe but forgot to update the runtime mapping in deployment bundle. Canary only at 10% but that was enough to trigger overload on the fallback nodes.
ryan-oncall: priority: rollback canary tag mapping OR reduce canary to 0. Who can flip? @ben-eng @carla-ops
ben-eng: I can cut the canary tag immediately. Suggest `deployctl rollback-tag shortseq-rollout` — doing a dry-run now, will flip in 30s if no objections.
carla-ops: go for it, inform customers and support. I'll add a note to the ticket queue.
deploy-bot: Executing: `deployctl rollback-tag shortseq-rollout --force`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 2026-03-17T08:12:04Z, target routing restored to pre-rollout state.
leo-sre: Metrics: 5xx rate dropping — 1.6% at 08:14 and trending down. Latency p95 improving.
support-ana: customer update sent: "We observed a transient routing regression during a staged rollout causing elevated 502s. We've rolled back the change and are monitoring. Sorry for the disruption." :white_check_mark:
ben-eng: root cause summary for now: tagging/name mismatch between canary routing and runtime kernel manifest. Action items:
- maya-ml: update rollout recipe to sync tag names with kernel manifests, add validation in CI (check runtime manifest vs routing tags).
- eng-runtime (ben-eng): add defensive reject in router for unknown kernel tag (fail fast with 4xx instead of routing to overloaded fallback).
- ops (carla-ops): update customer-facing postmortem stub and notify billing about potential doubled usage cases.
maya-ml: will prep a small PR + CI test today. Also propose setting canary weight threshold to 5% for kernel-sensitive changes.
ryan-oncall: keeping channel open for 30min monitoring. If numbers stable, we close. Thanks everyone. :pray:
leo-sre: no new alerts in the last 18m. Closing incident in 10m unless we see regression.
support-ana: closing customer tickets with notes, will reopen if anything new.
carla-ops: filing a short incident report and tagging eng/sre for postmortem.
ben-eng: adding an RFC for deployment guardrails to avoid tag/manifest drift.
ryan-oncall: incident closed at 2026-03-17T08:50:00Z — follow-ups on the backlog.
